svg.title: My approach
svg.desc: A seven-step problem-solving loop: 1 Find the pain and baseline it; 2 Map the process and systems; 3 Unify the context; 4 Design the agent; 5 Guardrails and humans at the right gates; 6 Prove it before go-live; 7 Measure the outcome, then expand. Each industry tab is one run of the loop.
svg.text: Every build follows the same problem-solving loop.
EACH INDUSTRY TAB BELOW IS ONE RUN OF THE LOOP
BFSI & Fintech: authority block, tenant isolation
IT services: P1/P2 hard block, confirm gates
